idea-plugin.name: Nim using nimlangserver
idea-plugin.description:
Full Nim language support powered by nimlangserver or nimlsp via LSP4IJ.
  • Code completion, parameter info, and hover documentation
  • Go to definition, find usages, document highlight, go to symbol, and rename refactoring
  • Inline diagnostics and inlay hints
  • Code formatting via nph or nimpretty (Reformat Code / Ctrl+Alt+L)
  • Smart Enter indentation with 2-space default
  • Syntax highlighting with bracket matching and auto-close
  • Run a single file by right-clicking a .nim file (nim r), or run/test a project via its .nimble file
  • New project wizard for Nim projects
  • Nimble dependencies and Nim standard library added as navigable project libraries

This is a community plugin, not officially supported by JetBrains or the Nim project.

Getting Started
  1. Install Nim and Nimble: nim-lang.org/install.html
  2. nimlangserver is auto-installed by the plugin if missing; or install manually: nimble install -g --useSystemNim nimlangserver
  3. (Optional) Install nph or nimpretty for formatting: nimble install nph
  4. Open Settings → Languages & Frameworks → Nim and set the Nim SDK path and the Nimble toolchain path; the tool executables are filled in automatically.
  5. Open any .nim, .nims, or .nimble file — LSP features activate automatically.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.1
  • Removed the unused nimsuggest executable setting; it was detected and shown but never invoked. Nim's tooling is reached through nim and the language server
  • Unix tool detection now uses which instead of whereis, which fixes SDK auto-detection on macOS (its whereis prints bare paths without the nim: label the parser expected)
0.6.0
  • Settings reworked around a Nim SDK path and a Nimble toolchain path (the Nimble bin directory), both pickable with a directory chooser; the tool executables are detected as absolute paths
  • Tool detection searches the configured paths, then where (Windows) / whereis (Unix), then common install locations and choosenim toolchains
  • Formatting supports nph (preferred) as well as nimpretty, with new "Set to use nph" / "Set to use nimpretty" buttons
  • The Nim standard library is now taken from the SDK's own lib/
  • Existing settings migrate automatically; a missing language server executable still means "nim check on save"
0.5.0
  • nim check problems (LSP-free mode) now appear in the Problems tool window, not just as editor markup
  • nim check (LSP-free mode) now also runs immediately when a .nim file is opened, not just on save
  • Nim standard library project library now shows its version, e.g. "Nim 2.0.0"
0.4.0
  • LSP-free mode: leave the language server executable empty (or click "Set to use nim check on save") and nim check runs on every save, marking errors/warnings/hints in the editor
  • "Reset to Defaults" and LSP preset buttons in the Nim settings page
  • Fix: "Nimble project refreshed" balloon no longer shown for non-nimble projects
  • Right-click any .nim file to create a "nim r" run configuration, not just .nimble files
0.3.0
  • Initial Windows support (untested, please report issues!)
0.2.0
  • nimlangserver is auto-installed via nimble if missing
  • New project wizard now has all features of nimble init
  • tests/ directory automatically marked as test source root
  • all executable names are now configurable, enabling nimlsp
  • Nimble dependencies wired as project libraries for source navigation
  • Nim standard library added as a "Nim" project library
  • Customizable syntax highlighting colors
0.1.0 (initial release)
  • Nim language support via nimlangserver and LSP4IJ
  • Syntax highlighting, bracket matching, and auto-close quotes
  • Smart Enter indentation
  • Code formatting via nimpretty (Reformat Code / Ctrl+Alt+L)
  • Run and test configurations
  • New project wizard
  • Source root detection from .nimble files
  • Project structure re-configured automatically when .nimble file changes
